title: DEPHYRIER Hexagonal Recursivo (Shape Word No Graph)
style: shape-word pulse 100 bpm trilingual EN PT FR DEPHYRIER signature topology-without-diagram geometric-vapor minimal-kick spoken-portuguese ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Recursive hexagonal topology the post named
As if the geometry alone could be claimed
No diagram no nodes no edges drawn straight
A shape word standing in for the actual state

[Pre-Chorus — Portuguese]
Hexagonal recursivo palavra sem desenho
(Recursive hexagonal word without drawing)
A forma sem vértices não tem domínio
(The shape without vertices has no domain)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER no diagram no nodes no edge
Hexagonal recursivo palavra sin grafo
(Recursive hexagonal word without graph)
Hexagonal récursif sans le schéma
(Recursive hexagonal without the schema)

[Verse 2]
Geometry is not a deployment surface
A word for a shape is not the architecture
If you cannot show the graph then the shape is talk
Name the file name the host or the topology mock

[Bridge — French]
La forme sans le graphe est une fumée
(The shape without the graph is smoke)
Nomme le nœud ou le mot s'est envolé
(Name the node or the word has flown)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER hexagonal no graph drawn
Recursivo sin vértices nada que ver
DEPHYRIER pas de nœud pas de forme
